findings.message: CMake platform condition `APPLE` has no QNX case
findings.suggestion: This branch selects sources, flags or libraries per platform but never names QNX. QNX toolchain files set CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME to QNX (and often QNX TRUE), and QNX notes that CMake conditionals checking CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME need to be extended for QNX; decide whether QNX belongs in this condition (e.g. add `AND NOT CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME STREQUAL "QNX"` or an elseif branch).

findings.message: Linux accept4 API accept4()
findings.suggestion: accept4() is provided by the QNX 8.0 io-sock stack (FreeBSD semantics; see FreeBSD accept(2)). io-sock applications link against libsocket.so (-l socket); there is no libsocket.a.

findings.message: Linux pipe2 API pipe2()
findings.suggestion: pipe2() is in QNX 8.0 libc but supports only O_CLOEXEC and O_NONBLOCK flags; check that no other flags (e.g. O_DIRECT) are passed.
